name: atlas-engineering-tools
description: Software delivery, academic research, Office workflows, wiring and PCB design.

interface.longDescription: Specify, plan, implement, debug and review software; develop foundational Three.js graphics code; conduct structured research; work with Office documents; inspect agent skills; and develop embedded firmware, wiring diagrams and PCB designs. This curated collection combines community-developed skills from popular GitHub projects and selected specialist repositories. It is not an official product or endorsement of the original maintainers. Upstream licenses apply; some workflows require local runtimes, configured accounts, API keys or paid services.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me specify, implement, review, or diagnose a software project and inspect agent skills.
